facts.fact: WordStream reports typical TikTok cost per click of $0.30 to $1.50, updated August 3, 2026.
facts.quote: Cost per click: $0.30 to $1.50 (WordStream, updated August 3, 2026)

facts.fact: WordStream reports typical TikTok cost per 1,000 impressions of $4 to $10.
facts.quote: Cost per 1,000 impressions: $4 to $10 (WordStream)

facts.fact: WordStream reports typical TikTok cost per view of $0.01 to $0.07.
facts.quote: Cost per view: $0.01 to $0.07 (WordStream)

facts.fact: Affect Group's US account data, reported by Darkroom, puts TikTok CPM at about $7 for reach up to $32 for lead generation in Q2 2026.
facts.quote: CPM by objective, US accounts, Q2 2026: from $7 for reach up to $32 for lead generation

facts.fact: TikTok's own budgeting guidance recommends a daily ad group budget of $30 in North America.
facts.unit: USD per day per ad group
facts.quote: recommends a daily ad group budget of $30 in North America

facts.fact: Stackmatix's 2026 pricing breakdown lists a $20 per day minimum per ad group and $50 per day per campaign for TikTok.
facts.quote: lists $20/day per ad group and $50/day per campaign

facts.fact: TikTok says performance settles at about 25 results per ad group, according to Darkroom.
facts.quote: TikTok says performance settles at about 25 results per ad group

facts.fact: Darkroom calculates that at a $20 daily ad group budget and the average 2025 cost per action, collecting 25 results takes about 41 days.
facts.quote: Darkroom calculates that collecting those 25 results takes about 41 days

facts.fact: Stackmatix reports TikTok recommends a daily budget of at least 10 times the target cost per acquisition for conversion campaigns.
facts.unit: times target cost per acquisition per day
facts.quote: TikTok recommends a daily budget of at least 10 times your target cost per acquisition

facts.fact: Adwave makes TikTok available at a daily budget of at least about $91, which is the opt-in level for the channel.
facts.quote: Set a daily budget of at least about $91, the level where TikTok becomes available.

facts.fact: In Adwave, TikTok is live and opt-in from about $91 per day.
facts.quote: In Adwave, TikTok is live and opt-in from about $91/day.

facts.fact: Adwave's TV, Google (Search and YouTube), Facebook and Instagram, and mobile web and app channels each run from a $30 per day minimum.
facts.quote: | Mobile web and mobile apps | From the $30/day minimum |

facts.fact: Adwave's Reddit channel runs from about $35 per day.
facts.quote: | Reddit | From about $35/day |

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page lists extra creative at $6 per additional social video, $0.38 per image, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot, charged from the wallet.
facts.quote: $6 per additional social video, $0.38 per image, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: As a planning example, the page states $91 a day for 30 active days comes to $2,730.
facts.quote: $91 a day for 30 active days comes to $2,730

facts.fact: Per the Adwave FAQ, card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout while ACH deposits have no added fee.
facts.quote: ACH deposits have no added fee

facts.fact: TikTok's Ads Manager setup asks for basic business details including country, time zone, billing currency and legal business name before a campaign is built.
facts.quote: you create an account and enter basic business details such as country, time zone, billing currency and legal business name

facts.fact: In Adwave, TikTok ads do not run when the daily budget is below about $91 a day.
facts.quote: Below about $91 a day, TikTok doesn’t run in Adwave

facts.fact: In Adwave, Facebook and Instagram ads open at a $30 minimum.
facts.quote: open at the $30 minimum and reach a wider age range

facts.fact: In Adwave, Reddit ads open from about $35 a day.
facts.quote: open from about $35 a day

facts.fact: Adwave's reports include assisted conversions as well as last-touch credit.
facts.quote: the reports include assisted conversions as well as last-touch credit

facts.fact: Adwave does not promise a particular return from TikTok or any other channel.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t promise a particular return from TikTok or from any other channel.

facts.fact: TikTok offers limited attribution windows, so it often gets no credit under last-click reporting.
facts.quote: TikTok offers limited attribution windows, and it often works early in a customer’s decision.
